Horizontal list of Tab triggers that switches between related panels of content within the same view. One tab is active at a time; tabs are peers, not steps. Available in the pill variant (tabs sit on a recessed track, for compact segmented switching). Composed of: Tab. In code, Tabs is the root, TabsList is the track shown in Figma, and TabsPanel holds the content of each panel.
